case_variable: observed non-taxicab parking occupancy of a designated and appropriately signed taxicab stand
fixed_context: same authored road, stand polygon, sign request, actor class, weather and hold interval; compare stationary frames after approach
reference_request: non-taxicab passenger vehicle stationary at x=60 m in the driving lane outside the stand polygon
contrast_request: non-taxicab passenger vehicle stationary at x=60 m inside the authored curb stand polygon
fallback1_trigger: fewer than 20 visible stand/sign frames in the first 40 saved frames: slower approach request
fallback2_trigger: observed curb-stand center deviation above 0.2 m: elevated overview camera request
fallback3_trigger: official designation, sign appropriateness, vehicle use or passenger-loading exception unverified: stop before stand request
required_original_evidence: generated Native map, curb stand polygon, sign content, placement, condition, authority and spatial applicability
240 actual actor poses, body vertices, speed and synchronized camera frames
observed non-taxicab use and destination parking purpose
continuous occupancy and stop duration in the stand versus outside it
door, passenger count, loading activity and approaching taxicab evidence to adjudicate the exception
source-hashed human review, accepted legal comparison and statutory verdict
request_limit: Eight authored trajectories are unselected CPU proposals. The sign and stand are authored objects; official designation, appropriate signing, actual parking and exception status are unverified.
